title: A rate-limited provider triggers bounded jittered retry and returns one adapter result on budget exhaustion
asA: operator whose project is receiving rate-limit refusals from the provider
iWant: the adapter to retry inside a bounded budget with jittered backoff and then surface one clean failure
soThat: a transient rate-limit refusal converts to a bounded delay rather than a retry storm the caller has to defend against

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED` provider return the adapter retries with exponential backoff and full jitter and stops on either a successful attempt or the configured retry budget, whichever comes first; the number of SMTP submissions equals `1 + observed_retries` and observed_retries is at most the configured budget (default 2).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project instrumented to count SMTP submissions and a provider seam that returns rate-limited on the first attempt and accepts on a later attempt within the budget
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submission counter after the adapter returns equals `1 + observed_retries`, `observed_retries` is at least one and at most the configured budget, and the returned object has `ok === true`

acceptanceCriteria.description: When every attempt in the budget window returns rate-limited, the adapter returns exactly one result with `ok: false`, `error` starting with `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED`, and the submission counter equals `1 + configured_budget`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with a provider seam that returns rate-limited on every attempt and configured retry budget of 2
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the adapter returns once, `ok === false`, `error` starts with `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED`, and the SMTP submission counter equals 3

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a `RESEND_SENDER_UNVERIFIED` or `RESEND_RECIPIENT_REJECTED` provider return the adapter does not retry; the submission counter after the adapter returns equals 1.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with a provider seam that returns the terminal-invalid class on the first attempt
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submission counter equals 1 and the returned object has `ok === false` with `error` starting with the terminal class code

acceptanceCriteria.description: A generic transport failure (a TCP reset, a DNS resolution error, an SMTP handshake timeout) is classified as retryable per REQ-003; the adapter retries up to the bounded attempt count, and on eventual success within the attempt budget resolves with the message envelope id returned by Resend.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a send call to the adapter with the SMTP client forced to reject on the first attempt with ECONNRESET and accept on the second attempt with envelope id "smtp-envelope-777"
acceptanceCriteria.then: send() resolves with envelope id "smtp-envelope-777"; the adapter records exactly two attempts on the internal counter; no RESEND_TRANSPORT_ERROR is returned to the caller

acceptanceCriteria.description: A generic transport failure that persists across the full attempt budget rejects with RESEND_TRANSPORT_ERROR naming the final transport class and the final attempt count (two per ADR-402); the caller sees no fabricated success envelope.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a send call with the SMTP client forced to reject on every attempt with ECONNRESET
acceptanceCriteria.then: send() rejects with RESEND_TRANSPORT_ERROR naming ECONNRESET and attemptCount 2; no envelope id is returned

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider 5xx response (a Resend server-side error) is classified as retryable per REQ-003 and REQ-004; the adapter retries with exponential full-jitter backoff and asserts that the scheduled delay before attempt 2 lies in [0, 250] milliseconds (base 250ms, first attempt) and before attempt 3 (if reached in a longer budget) would lie in [0, 500] milliseconds (2x base, capped at 8000ms). Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent supplies the deterministic jitter source and clock; the AC substitutes the ADR-402 baseline retry parameters (base, cap, attempts).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a send call with a deterministic jitter source (jitter() -> 0.5) and a deterministic clock, the SMTP client forced to return 5xx on every attempt, and the ADR-402 baseline (2 attempts, base 250ms, cap 8000ms, exponential full-jitter)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the adapter schedules exactly one retry; the delay before the retry equals 125ms (0.5 * 250 * 1); send() rejects with RESEND_TRANSPORT_ERROR naming the provider 5xx and attemptCount 2; no delay exceeds 8000ms and no delay is negative
